chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 110: Li Huowang’s Bitter Victory & the Maggot Wound
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang wins his battle against Danyangzi, but the cost is a maggot-infested wound and a lie he can’t unsay. Anci Nunnery’s true power is revealed.
og_title: A Victory That Feels Like a Wound
og_description: The calm after the storm in Ch. 110 of Dao Gui Yi Xian. Li Huowang smiles, sends his friends away, and reveals a belly full of maggots.
twitter_description: Li Huowang won, but the maggots in his gut say otherwise. Ch. 110 of Dao Gui Yi Xian is a masterclass in Pyrrhic horror.
